exercises.title: A Job Interview Call-Back
exercises.scenario: An HR manager calls a candidate with details about a job offer.
exercises.instruction: Listen to the audio and write the missing word or number in each gap.
exercises.audio_text: Congratulations! We would like to offer you the position. The office is located at 145 Kingsway, behind the building with the navy blue door, and the postcode is wc2 5rt. The starting salary would be thirty-two thousand pounds a year, and you would be working with a team of nine people. Since you are twenty-seven years old, you would qualify for the standard pension plan after three years. Please call us back on 020 7946 three hundred and twelve, extension forty-six.

The starting salary would be {{b4}} a year, and you would be working with a team of {{b5}} people. Since you are {{b6}} years old, you would qualify for the standard pension plan after {{b7}} years. Please call us back on 020 7946 three hundred and twelve, extension {{b8}}.

The starting salary would be thirty-two thousand pounds a year, and you would be working with a team of nine people. Since you are twenty-seven years old, you would qualify for the standard pension plan after three years. Please call us back on 020 7946 three hundred and twelve, extension forty-six.

blanks.cue: What is the office street number?
How many people are on the team?
After how many years would the pension apply?

exercises.title: Renting a Holiday Cottage
exercises.scenario: A property agent describes a holiday cottage over the phone.
exercises.instruction: Listen to the audio and write the missing word or number in each gap.
exercises.audio_text: The cottage is a lovely whitewashed building near the coast. It is one hundred and fifty years old and it sleeps up to six guests. The address is 7 Harbour View, and the postcode is tr4 9pl. The weekly rate is four hundred pounds, and the owner, who is sixty-three years old, asks for a deposit of one hundred pounds before you arrive.

The weekly rate is {{b6}}, and the owner, who is {{b7}} years old, asks for a deposit of {{b8}} before you arrive.
exercises.transcript: The cottage is a lovely whitewashed building near the coast. It is one hundred and fifty years old and it sleeps up to six guests. The address is 7 Harbour View, and the postcode is tr4 9pl. The weekly rate is four hundred pounds, and the owner, who is sixty-three years old, asks for a deposit of one hundred pounds before you arrive.

blanks.cue: How many guests can it sleep?

exercises.title: Registering at a New Clinic
exercises.scenario: A receptionist registers a new patient over the phone at a busy clinic.
exercises.instruction: Listen to the audio and write the missing word or number in each gap.
exercises.audio_text: Welcome to Elmwood Clinic. Can I confirm your details? You are forty-nine years old, and your address is 62 Elmwood Gardens, postcode ne3 8jq. Your emergency contact number ends in five. You will be seeing Doctor Patel on the second floor, in the room with the cream walls. Your appointment lasts twenty minutes, and the clinic has been open for twelve years.
